description.value:
You know how to rig the game before it even begins. The second card you Draw after rolling initiative is also a @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.hrym9yIlzu0ZQOfx]{Cardplay: Wildcard}. If you are in an extradimensional space that you made when you roll initiative, your third card is also a Wild Card.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.twI5GDV8k8soVglF]{Card Shark} feat, you can immediately store a Wild Card as you Draw it. If you are in an extradimensional space you made, the seam you make with Card Shark functions normally as if it stores the card in a fold of your extradimensional space. If you drew a third Wild Card in your extradimensional space, you cannot bring it out of the space with your seam.
